When it comes to the holidays, I tend to rely on the same list of tried-and-true cookie recipes year after year and hardly ever stray. A recipe has to be truly special and reliable to get on my lineup. These hot chocolate cookies — complete with a surprise marshmallow middle — are one-of-a-kind. The chocolate drop-style dough is pretty standard, but it has a little hot cocoa mix added in for both flavor and to help produce its sink-your-teeth-into-it texture.
